title.text: Aurora Tonight — whether, when, where to go, and were we right

loop.text: How it is used: forecast → alert → drive to a spot. No accounts, no server: the app checks the forecast on the phone and notifies once per night; accuracy is checked against public all-sky cameras, not user reports (ADR 14). All numbers on these screens are sample data.

webtitle.text: Web — same screens, desktop layout; static site on GitHub Pages, shareable spot pages and scorecard

web.text: The website is static (GitHub Pages) and shares the model and logic with the app through packages/. On wide screens Tonight and the map sit side by side. Alerts exist only in the app, because a browser cannot run in the background.
